name: ScratchCards
author: Elvin
short: Weighted multi-prize scratch card game integrated with Red's bank
description: buy configurable scratch cards, win weighted prizes deposited to Red's bank. Includes an admin UI to create/edit cards and prizes via buttons and modals.
install_msg: Thank you for installing! Use [p]scratch manage to create cards and [p]scratch to see all commands. Requires Red's bank to be enabled. If you enjoy my cogs and wish to support me then please consider donating via [Ko-Fi](https://ko-fi.com/dasvino)!
